catholic-encyclopedia-1913-andreas-pozzo: This 1913 reference article on Andrea Pozzo — the Jesuit master of illusion. Gerhard Gietmann praises his ceilings. His St. Ignatius dome deceives the eye. Perspective became his theology. The painter of heavenly vaults. His treatise taught the painters' art. His altar glows in the Gesu.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-arezzo: A 1913 entry on Arezzo — the Tuscan diocese of the hill town. John Joseph A'Becket gives its story. Its cathedral crowns the Etruscan height. Petrarch was born within its walls. A see of the Arno's valley. Its Piero frescoes draw the pilgrims.
